items.text: Approving parking restrictions and amending Transportation Code, Division II, Section 801 to allow only marked San Francisco Fire Department (SFFD) vehicles to park on the east side of Stanford Street, from Townsend Street to 220 feet northerly at all times and converting existing 2-Hour Residential Permit Parking from 220 feet to 440 feet north of Townsend Street Monday through Friday from 6 AM to 4 PM to SFFD vehicle restricted parking (The SFMTA, under authority delegated by the Planning Department, has determined that the proposed parking and traffic modifications are categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act [CEQA]. The proposed action is the Approval Action as defined by the S.F. Administrative Code Chapter 31. Explanatory documents include a staff report and resolution.): A. RESCIND – 2-HOUR PARKING, 8 AM TO 10 PM, EVERYDAY, EXCEPT VEHICLES WITH AREA Y PERMITS Stanford Street, east side, from 100 feet to 440 feet north of Townsend Street B. RESCIND – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING, EXCEPT VEHICLES WITH PERMITS ISSUED BY SFFD. Stanford Street, east side, from Townsend Street to 100 feet northerly C. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING, EXCEPT MARKED SFFD. VEHICLES, AT ALL TIMES Stanford Street, east side, from Townsend Street to 220 feet northerly 6 D. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING, 6 AM TO 4 PM, MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY, EXCEPT MARKED SFFD. VEHICLES Stanford Street, east side, from 220 feet to 440 feet north of Townsend Street RESOLUTION No. 250401-025
